authority: Independent synthetic PasswordSafe V3 fixture metadata

mutations.wrong_password: Use a different fabricated passphrase against the unchanged password check.
mutations.wrong_hmac: Flip one bit in the final stored HMAC.
mutations.missing_version: Omit the required first Version header field while retaining a valid envelope HMAC.
mutations.version_length_one: Encode the first Version field with a one-byte payload and a valid envelope HMAC.
mutations.missing_header_end: Reach encrypted EOF while still routing header fields.
mutations.missing_record_end: Reach encrypted EOF while one record remains open.
mutations.missing_record_mandatory: End a record without UUID, Title, or Password.
mutations.truncation: Remove bytes from the fixed prefix, encrypted region, EOF marker, or stored HMAC.
mutations.length_overrun: Replace a decrypted field length with uint32 maximum without adding ciphertext.
mutations.resource_counts: Exceed caller-selected field or record budgets with authenticated fields.
mutations.large_deferred: Use an authenticated opaque payload above the inline threshold and stream it before publication.
